test_title: PYST 7: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef599ed4454ede171eab9c827768be45bb221e4c114e809871e449dbfa291b77.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) **For first box alternate series of top elements ****:** 

 
• Alternately top left corner element shifts to top center position.
 
• Alternately top center element shifts to bottom center positions. 
 
• Alternately top right corner element shifts to center position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/598d253bc4a9a72bc7e3c753609b9a9fb6d4bd0e328276b3c6c2e5ff9fc5b90d.png] 

2) For second box alternate series of top elements :

 
• Alternately top left corner element shifts to center position.
 
• Alternately top center element shifts to top right corner position. 
 
• Alternately top right corner element shifts to bottom center position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11add50851452651647f6182e6559582126c849729f22c5d7ff6b04a39591993.png] 

3) For center element : Shifts to the bottom right corner position subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/753a9079a436d11209aac71aff4de1e3ee9cd0ca9a432e1ee5adb0c326d69a10.png] 

4) For first box alternate series of bottom elements :

 
• Alternately bottom left corner element shifts to top left corner position.
 
• Alternately bottom center element shifts to bottom left corner position. 
 
• Alternately bottom right corner element shifts to top right corner position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed322cad45f14dda44d5ca67696cd91ba23ecdb84e342459d17bd1c9d47bdf37.png] 

5) For second box alternate series of bottom elements :

 
• Alternately bottom left corner element shifts to top center position.
 
• Alternately bottom center element shifts to bottom left corner position. 
 
• Alternately bottom right corner element shifts to top left corner position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d95cd217e241f58c8a653ef80a23b0b696d4846985d0906519ccaee3c87bd56.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2a370d0731255b7f94ba7fffe3cfc126e931fb982c4c94269ec66620c23f9aa.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (1)’ is the correct answer.
